title: PromptShield
subtitle: LLM Prompt Injection Detection & Prevention Gateway
description: Full-stack security gateway analyzing prompts, assigning risk scores, and intercepting injection threats before reaching LLMs.
todoArchitecture: TODO: Add PromptShield architecture diagram to /public/images/projects/promptshield-architecture.png
highlights: Full-stack Next.js 16 / TypeScript security gateway that analyzes each prompt, assigns a 0–100 risk score, and allows, warns, sanitizes, or blocks it before it reaches the LLM.

Detects prompt injection, jailbreaks, system-prompt leaks, role override, credential probing, and tool abuse using a two-layer defense: client-side pattern guard plus server-side proxy through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OmniRoute).
API secured with Firebase Admin ID-token verification (incl. revocation checks) and server-only credentials; dashboard modules for secured chat, playground, incidents, analytics, and audit logs.

Configurable policy engine (thresholds; allow/warn/sanitize/block actions), Firestore security rules, incident and audit logging, a programmatic analysis API, and probe / sanitization-verification scripts.
features: 0–100 Real-Time Risk Scoring Engine
Two-Layer Defense (Client Pattern Guard + Server-Side OmniRoute Proxy)
Multi-Threat Detection (Injection, Jailbreaks, System Leak, Role Override, Credential Probing)
Firebase Admin ID-Token Verification with Revocation Checks
Configurable Policy Engine (Allow, Warn, Sanitize, Block Actions)
Telemetry Dashboards: Secured Chat, Playground, Incidents, Analytics, and Audit Logs
problem: LLM integrations in modern applications are exposed to adversarial prompt injection, credential exfiltration, role overrides, and system-prompt extraction. Standard application layers lack pre-execution inspection to neutralize threats before they reach costly or sensitive upstream LLMs.
approach: Built a comprehensive full-stack Next.js 16 / TypeScript security gateway enforcing a two-layer defense: an immediate client-side pattern guard combined with an authenticated server-side proxy routing through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OmniRoute). Configured a policy engine that evaluates multi-vector threat scores to allow, warn, sanitize, or block queries dynamically.
architecture: Full-stack Next.js 16 App Router architecture in TypeScript with Tailwind CSS. Firebase Admin SDK verifies ID tokens with strict revocation checks and server-only credentials. Requests pass through a dual inspection pipeline (pattern heuristics + server proxy) before forwarding to upstream LLMs via OmniRoute. Firestore security rules protect multi-tenant audit logs, incident reports, and real-time security analytics.

title: CampusAI
subtitle: Voice-Enabled College Reception Robot
description: Kiosk interface with a 3D robot, audio visualizer, and multilingual voice assistant for college reception (Final-Year Major Project, IT & EXTC).

highlights: My part: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion and React Three Fiber kiosk interface with a 3D robot and idle/listening/thinking/speaking states for a multilingual (English, Hindi, Marathi, Hinglish) voice assistant.
Touchscreen kiosk UI with an audio visualizer, QR route display, and custom hooks for Web Audio recording, WebSocket, and REST clients.

Multilingual Voice Assistant (English, Hindi, Marathi, Hinglish)
Touchscreen Kiosk UI with Real-Time Audio Visualizer
Dynamic QR Route Display for Campus Navigation
Custom React Hooks for Web Audio Recording, WebSocket, and REST Streaming
problem: College visitors, parents, and incoming students encounter navigation confusion and repetitive queries at administrative reception desks. Campus kiosks need an intuitive, physical-robot interface capable of natural, voice-driven interaction in multiple local dialects.
approach: Engineered a touch-enabled, 3D interactive kiosk frontend in Next.js and React Three Fiber representing the reception robot. Implemented low-latency audio capture with Web Audio API, dynamic state animations (idle/listening/thinking/speaking), audio visualizers, and QR route generators. title: KrishiSaathi
subtitle: Farm-to-Market Marketplace Platform
description: Full-stack marketplace connecting farmers directly with buyers with an ARIMA price forecasting engine trained on AGMARKNET mandi data.
highlights: Full-stack marketplace connecting farmers directly with buyers (18,300+ commodity price records) with an ARIMA model trained on AGMARKNET mandi price data to forecast prices.
Hybrid Firestore and MongoDB architecture with real-time cart sync and role-based farmer and buyer dashboards.
Google, Facebook, and Apple OAuth, Razorpay payments, and 8-language commodity search; bundle size cut 69% (2.9MB to 900KB) via code splitting.
Filed for copyright registration, Indian Copyright Office (Diary No. SW-21662/2026-CO), currently in re-scrutiny.
features: Real-time cart synchronization
Interactive farmer & buyer dashboards
AGMARKNET mandi price forecasting via ARIMA
Razorpay checkout flow
8-language commodity search
problem: Indian farmers lose 25–40% of revenue to middlemen in traditional mandi (market) systems. No direct-to-buyer digital platform existed that combined real-time market price intelligence with a streamlined e-commerce flow for agricultural commodities.
approach: Built a full-stack marketplace with a price-prediction engine trained on government data. Designed a hybrid database architecture combining Firestore's real-time sync with MongoDB's flexibility for complex commodity queries. Implemented role-based dashboards for farmers and buyers with multi-language search support.
architecture: Hybrid Firestore + MongoDB architecture — Firestore handles real-time cart sync and user sessions, while MongoDB manages the commodity catalog and price history. ARIMA-based price prediction model trained on 18,300+ rows of AGMARKNET government mandi data. React frontend with code-split routes, Node.js/Express API layer, Razorpay payment integration, and OAuth via Google/Facebook/Apple.

copyrightFiled.status: Filed with Indian Copyright Office (Currently in re-scrutiny)

title: IMDB Movie Review Sentiment
subtitle: NLP Sentiment Classifier for 50,000 IMDB Reviews
description: Natural language processing classifier evaluating Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, and Bidirectional LSTM models on 50,000 reviews.
highlights: Built an NLP sentiment classifier for 50,000 IMDB reviews using TF-IDF feature extraction.
Evaluated Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, and Bidirectional LSTM models on accuracy and F1-score.
Implemented comprehensive text preprocessing and comparative performance evaluation.
features: TF-IDF numerical feature extraction pipeline
Multi-model comparison: Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Bidirectional LSTM
Accuracy and F1-score evaluation metrics
problem: Manual review classification is inefficient and error-prone, requiring automated natural language understanding pipelines to accurately determine sentiment in movie reviews.
approach: Developed an end-to-end NLP and machine learning pipeline to preprocess raw IMDB text data, extract TF-IDF features, and train supervised classifiers with extensive evaluation.
architecture: Python NLP pipeline utilizing Scikit-learn (Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes) and TensorFlow/Keras neural network models for binary classification.

title: MedTalk – AI Healthcare Chatbot
subtitle: 24/7 Multilingual AI Healthcare Chatbot
description: Voice-enabled preliminary healthcare guidance chatbot utilizing the Google Gemini API, Speech-to-Text, and Text-to-Speech.
highlights: Developed a 24/7 multilingual AI chatbot using the Google Gemini API with voice-based interaction (Google Cloud Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech).
Built a secure Flask REST backend for preliminary healthcare guidance with robust query resolution.
Integrated natural language understanding to deliver accessible healthcare guidance across languages.
features: Multilingual voice conversation (STT & TTS)
Clinical query reasoning via Google Gemini API
Secure Flask REST API backend
problem: Healthcare access in multilingual regions is limited by language barriers and the unavailability of medical professionals around the clock.
approach: Built a voice-enabled AI chatbot powered by Google Gemini API for medical query understanding, with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech for voice interactions.
architecture: Python/Flask backend serving a RESTful API with Google Gemini API for natural language understanding and Google Cloud STT/TTS for voice processing.
